title: ReleaseHarnessVerdict
description: The adjudication of one run: what each assertion did, who is responsible for any failure, and whether the run was entitled to certify. Computed deterministically from sealed observations -- the same inputs always produce this same document, because it is hashed into the run manifest and any variation would break verification for honest runs.

status.description: PASS is reachable only by a certifying run. An exploratory run that breaks nothing is UNPROVEN, because a PASS claims an accepted proposition holds and an exploratory run has none.

run_integrity.description: Whether the run's own machinery held up. Distinct from whether the subject passed: a run whose evidence did not seal supports no conclusion in either direction.

causes.description: The distinct causes present, sorted. Only PRODUCT accuses the subject, and only a substantiated one appears here.

authoritative.description: Whether this attribution may be reported as a finding about the subject. An exploratory run's product reading is downgraded, never silently relabelled.
